notes: Stories validated and aligned to required breakdown. No duplicates created.

stories.title: Consent Schema and Contract Validation Fixes
stories.description: Audit and correct Pydantic models in consent_models.py to enforce strict Tier 1 vs Tier 2 separation, required fields, consent timestamps, and de-identification flags. Ensure backward compatibility with existing stored records.

stories.title: Core Consent Logic Edge Case Fixes
stories.description: Fix defects in consent_service.py including improper tier escalation, duplicate consent submissions, partial consent persistence, summarization failures, and HIPAA Safe Harbor de-identification inconsistencies.

stories.title: Consent Enforcement via API and Tool Router
stories.description: Ensure consent enforcement is consistently applied through tool_router.py and FastAPI entrypoints, including gating before lead capture and unknown question flows, and preventing bypass of Tier 2 consent requirements.

stories.title: Consent Workflow Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Expand automated test coverage for consent flows including Tier 1 only, Tier 2 escalation, refusal handling, duplicate submissions, and validation of de-identification behavior across services.

stories.title: Consent Integration with Lead and Unknown Question Services
stories.description: Fix integration inconsistencies between ConsentService, LeadService, and UnknownQuestionService to ensure consent state is consistently enforced across all entry points and that no PHI is persisted without valid Tier 2 consent.
